title: Peer Supporter
summary: Be the person who listens. You will talk with young people who need to be heard and help them find professional help when they need it.
responsibilities: Know when to point someone to a counsellor or helpline
Take part in our free training

title: Trainer / Guide
summary: Help us run our free peer support trainings and guide new peer supporters.
responsibilities: Share what you know about listening and mental health
lookingFor: Understands the basics of listening and referring someone for help

title: Chapter Lead
summary: Start and lead a Unity Within chapter in your campus or community.
responsibilities: Be the local face of Unity Within
lookingFor: A young person who cares about mental health and wants to lead

title: Research Collaborator
summary: Help us study how AI and new technology affect mental health.
responsibilities: Help plan and carry out research
Share ideas and skills in research, technology or mental health
lookingFor: Students, researchers and tech people who want to understand how technology changes the way young people feel
